one-line thesis: TII delivered robust consolidated growth (Revenue +21% YoY) driven by CG Power and core Engineering, while standalone EV mobility faced temporary supply constraints now resolved via in-house capacity capture. The strategic pivot to internalize body-in-white production and pending railway certifications positions FY27 for accelerated volume recovery despite near-term commodity cost headwinds.
financial scorecard: Consolidated Revenue Rs.6,215cr (+20.7% YoY), PBIT Rs.516cr (+7.7% YoY); Standalone Revenue Rs.2,279cr (+16.5% YoY), PBIT Rs.176cr (Eng) + Rs.35cr (MFP) + Rs.4cr (Mobility); CG Power Revenue Rs.3,442cr (+25% YoY), PBIT Rs.490cr (+27.6% YoY); Shanthi Gears Revenue Rs.135cr (-11.8% YoY), PBIT Rs.25cr (-19.4% YoY); One-off: Q4 EV volumes capped at ~50% potential due to supplier bottleneck resolution.
guidance: Standalone Capex Rs.300-350cr; Subsidiary Capex ~Rs.300cr; TI Medical growth 15-20% YoY; EV deployment ramping in Q1/Q2 FY27 post-infrastructure financing resolution; CDMO commercial production starts Q1 FY27.
order book & pipeline: EV Heavy Trucks: Strong order book cited (specific value undisclosed); Deployment pending financing/charging infra; Three-wheeler order flow recovering post-supply fix.
segment / subsidiary detail: Engineering: Rev Rs.1,495cr (+21.6% YoY), PBIT Rs.176cr; Metal Formed: Rev Rs.421cr (+4.5% YoY), PBIT Rs.35cr (-10% YoY) impacted by Hyundai muted growth/railway tender margins; Mobility (EV): Rev Rs.208cr (+14.9% YoY), PBIT Rs.4cr (flat); Volumes: 87 Big Trucks, 241 SCV, 1,176 Three-wheelers; Medical: Rev Rs.246cr (+0.8% YoY), PBIT Rs.16cr.
growth verticals / optionality: Railway Vande Bharat component certification (2-3 quarters away); CDMO plant commissioning (Naidupet); IV Cannula asset acquisition (Ambala) starting production Q1/Q2 FY27; EV long-haul battery swap vs. fast-charge technology pivot.
margins & cost dynamics: Commodity price inflation passed through with 1-2 quarter lag; Fuel cost inflation immediate challenge being negotiated; MFP margins pressured by low-margin railway tenders and Hyundai volume mix.
capex / expansion: Standalone Rs.300-350cr; Subsidiaries (EV + Medical) ~Rs.300cr; Focus on EV scaling, medical capacity, and CDMO finalization.
capital allocation: Dividend Rs.1.50/share (final) + Rs.2.00/share (interim); Free Cash Flow Rs.826cr (100% of PAT); Active M&A in medical (asset purchase closed).
risks & watch-items: EV financing availability for fleet operators; Charging infrastructure deployment delays; Railway approval timelines; Commodity price volatility lag; Geopolitical impact on medical exports (Middle East).
management quality / tone: Bullish on volume growth despite macro headwinds; Pragmatic on cost pass-through lags; Confident in supply chain fixes (BIW in-house); Strategic patience on railway/tech shifts.
non-obvious takeaways: EV three-wheeler volume miss was a deliberate short-term hit to solve a multi-year supplier bottleneck by acquiring the facility, enabling immediate ramp-up in April/May; Shift in long-haul EV strategy from battery-swap to high-capacity fast-charging based on China trends, though swap retained for ports.
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supply chain bottleneck resolved by in-house takeover | Tube Investments of India Ltd | beneficiary | High | BIW facility acquisition removes structural cap on 3W volumes; immediate ramp expected in Q1 FY27. |
| Commodity inflation lag and railway tender margin pressure | Shanthi Gears Ltd | loser | Med | Revenue declined 11.8% YoY; margin compression in gear segment due to product mix and slower industrial demand. |
| High deployment capex and charging infra gaps | CG Power & Industrial Solutions | beneficiary | High | Strong 25% revenue growth and 27% PBIT growth provide cash flow cushion for group; benefits from broader power capex cycle unrelated to EV infra delays. |

themes.title: Capital-goods & machine-tool import-substitution
themes.need: Atmanirbhar machine-tool and heavy-engineering localization is supply-constrained against import-substituting demand. JYOTICNC runs >100% utilization with a INR4,732cr order book and near-triples capacity; ELGIEQUIP/CUMMINSIND/ELECON/LMW ride the same capex + export + China+1 pull; ISGEC/BHEL/GMMPFAUDLR/KIRLPNU on process + energy capex.
themes.driver: Capacity expansion going live (JYOTICNC); defence/EMS order conversion; US-reshoring export demand (ELGIEQUIP).

themes.title: Auto components & EV-driveline localization
themes.need: Premiumization, content-per-vehicle rise and EV/hybrid transition pull a deep auto-ancillary chain - MOTHERSON/SONACOMS/BOSCHLTD/SCHAEFFLER/SKFINDIA/UNOMINDA-tier on driveline, bearings, wiring (MSUMI) and EV systems; OLAELEC/ATHERENERG/OLECTRA on EV OEMs (OLAELEC targeting cell-to-pack 10-15% cost edge); SUNDRMFAST/ENDURANCE/CRAFTSMAN/BHARATFORG on forgings/machining. Q1FY27 showed contracted pricing finally landing for Tier-2s: SSWL earned EBITDA/wheel of Rs 314 against Rs 262 YoY, which management attributed mostly to two years of OEM input-price increases finally landing (1-5%, more pending) rather than mix, with all plants above 95% utilisation and knuckles at 100%; KROSS delivered a 12.23% EBITDA margin (+63bps) BEFORE two retrospective pass-throughs land (steel settled ~15 July, the CV conversion-cost settlement still pending), making Q1 a floor rather than a peak.
themes.driver: GST 2.0 demand pull; retrospective OEM price pass-throughs still to land (KROSS CV conversion cost); EV cell/Gigafactory ramps (OLAELEC 6GWh by June); export + new-platform content wins.

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **Engineering:** Cold Drawn Welded (CDW) Tubes, Electric Resistance Welded (ERW) Tubes, Tubular Components, Cold Rolled Steel Strips (CRSS)
- **Metal Formed Products:** Automotive Chains, Fine Blanked Products, Roll-Formed Car Doorframes, Cold rolled formed sections for Railway Wagons & Passenger Coaches, Industrial Chains
- **Mobility:** Standard Bicycles, Special Bicycles including Alloy Bikes, Speciality Performance Bikes, Fitness Equipment, E-Bicycles
- **Gears:** Gears, Gear Boxes, Gear Motors, Gear & Gear Products, Electric Motors, Alternators, Drives, Traction, Electronic & SCADA, Industrial Systems
- **Power Systems:** Transformers, Switchgears, Automation & Turnkey Projects
- **Semiconductor:** Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Test (OSAT), Fabless Semiconductor Design Business, TMT, TI Optoelectronic Solutions
- **New Ventures (Electric Vehicles):** E-Three Wheeler, E-Tractor, E-M&HCV, E-SCV
